title: Anticipating Impacts: Using Large-Scale Scenario Writing to Explore Diverse Implications of Generative AI in the News Environment

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of future-oriented, fictional scenarios written by stakeholders (news consumers, technology developers, content creators) to identify anticipated negative impacts of generative AI, specifically focusing on themes of amplified biased narratives, lack of diversity, and discrimination against minority groups.

Qualitative thematic analysis of stakeholder-written scenarios to extract anticipated political impacts, including the misuse of generative AI for political manipulation, opinion monopolies, and the promotion of specific right-wing or populist agendas.
